identification: Mixed lot. Main item: a plain white autograph card (about 13 x 8 cm) hand-signed 'Mountbatten of Burma' (green-blue ink, underlined) and 'Edwina Mountbatten of Burma' (blue-black ink, underlined), two different pens. Titles fix the date to 1947-Feb 1960 (Earl from Oct 1947; Edwina died Feb 1960); the Mountbattens toured Australia/NZ in early 1956 (NSW State Library photo of them welcomed at Mascot; NZ press Mar 1956), so a 1956 Australian Government House dinner is the likely occasion, unproven. Separate unsigned crown-headed 'GOVERNMENT HOUSE' menu card, handwritten in blue ink (Pate du Perigord / Consomme Royale / Caneton Rouennais aux Cerises / Petits Pois, Pommes Allumettes / Omelette Siberienne); no date, no state named. Also: pair of worn embroidered Chinese silk child's shoes, carved soapstone shoe, two small cloisonne fruit-form (pear and apple) lidded boxes, an agate apple-form snuff bottle/box with green stone stopper, and a small filigree white-metal Viking longship ornament (Scandinavian souvenir type, likely 830 silver, unmarked in photo).

viewing_check: Under a loupe: real ink sitting in the paper with pressure and pooling at stroke ends (not printed dots or flat facsimile); check the card back for any date, place or note; check menu back for a date or guest names. Look for a mark on the Viking boat (830, 925, Norway) and weigh it. Check cloisonne boxes for chips and the agate apple stopper.
